en-US.summary: AuraStream: Ambient Living Room Co-Pilot & Multi-Modal AI Companion for Amazon Fire TV and Alexa+
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask AuraStream wait what did he just drop
Alexa, ask AuraStream catch me up without spoilers
Alexa, ask AuraStream what song is playing right now
en-US.name: AuraStream
en-US.description: AuraStream connects Amazon Alexa+ and Fire TV via the Model Context Protocol (MCP 2025-11-25+) and Amazon Bedrock Converse API. Ask about characters on screen, soundtrack scores, timestamp-locked spoiler-free recaps, live sports tactical formations, or control Fire TV playback hands-free.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Start the AuraStream server (python run.py) and expose /api/alexa/webhook via HTTPS (e.g., ngrok or AWS App Runner), or test directly via the built-in Alexa Simulator endpoint.
